action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate Rd4 at full depth to see if the engine's 4-exact score holds or if Black's reply Nxd4 exposes a tactic.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 1 suggests Rd4 (150, exact) wins the d4 knight by hitting it and the b6 bishop behind it. But Black's only listed reply in the PV is Bxd4, and my queen recaptures. I must verify this single candidate at max depth before committing, since broad scores are shallow and exact.
